title: Decision signing
intro: Ed25519 key in this browser, 15-minute passkey session and re-authentication when the rule requires it.
viewerBody: The viewer role never signs. You can review keys, but not create or revoke them.
unsupportedTitle: You can't sign from this browser
unsupportedBody: It doesn't support Ed25519 keys. You can review everything, but to sign use a recent version of Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.
unsupportedNever: We never sign on the server on your behalf.
unsupportedReason: This browser doesn't support Ed25519 keys
keyIntro: We will create your signing key in this browser. It can't be exported and never leaves this device.
createNote: If you switch browsers you will need to register another key. Old signatures remain verifiable.
sessionBody: Confirm with your passkey. It opens a 15-minute window for up to 10 signatures. Signing does not extend it.
sessionNone: There is no open signing session.
keysEmpty: You haven't registered any key yet.
revokeBody: The signing session is closed. Earlier signatures still verify with this key.
sessionLive: Session open: {count, plural, one {# signature left} other {# signatures left}}.
stepUpFailed: Passkey re-authentication could not start. Nothing was signed.
errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Nothing was signed.
sealedTitle: Key revoked with a signed decision

signFlow.noSession: Open a signing session first (signing indicator in the header).
signFlow.unsupported: This browser cannot hold a non-exportable Ed25519 key, so it cannot sign.
signFlow.mismatch: The server payload does not match its hash. Nothing was signed.
signFlow.failed: The decision could not be signed.
